foods.description: Zuppa fredda di pomodoro, peperone, cetriolo, aglio, pane, olio e aceto, fondamentale nelle estati andaluse. foods.description_en: A cold soup of tomato, pepper, cucumber, garlic, bread, oil and vinegar, fundamental in Andalusian summers. It should be fresh, smooth and lively: acidity, tomato sweetness and good oil must remain in balance. Quality is recognised in cold service and a velvety texture.
foods.description_fr: Une soupe froide de tomates, poivrons, concombre, ail, pain, huile d'olive et vinaigre, rafraîchissante et désaltérante. Le plat emblématique de l'été en Andalousie, servi comme boisson ou soupe dans tous les bars de Séville.

foods.description: Fette di pane imbevute in latte o vino, passate nell’uovo, fritte e cosparse di zucchero o miele, tipiche della Settimana Santa. Sono morbide, profumate e dolci, ma la qualità richiede frittura pulita e interno non zuppo.
foods.description_en: Slices of bread soaked in milk or wine, dipped in egg, fried and covered with sugar or honey, typical of Holy Week. They are soft, fragrant and sweet, but quality requires clean frying and an interior that is not soggy.
foods.description_fr: Des tranches de pain trempées dans du lait ou du vin, enrobées d'œuf, frites et recouvertes de sucre et cannelle. La version espagnole du pain perdu, traditionnellement préparée pendant la Semaine Sainte à Séville.

es.name: Torrijas

foods.name: Huevos a la flamenca
foods.description: Uova cotte al forno con pomodoro, piselli, peperoni, chorizo e talvolta patate o prosciutto, in terracotta. È un piatto colorato e generoso: tuorlo morbido, salsa saporita e ingredienti distribuiti senza diventare confusi. La qualità dipende dalla cottura dell’uovo, che non deve asciugarsi.
foods.description_en: Eggs baked with tomato, peas, peppers, chorizo and sometimes potatoes or ham, in an earthenware dish. It is colourful and generous: soft yolk, savoury sauce and ingredients distributed without becoming confused. Quality depends on egg cooking, which should never dry out.
foods.description_fr: Des œufs pochés au four dans une sauce de tomates, petits pois, poivrons, chorizo et pommes de terre. Un plat coloré et convivial de la cuisine populaire d'Andalousie, servi directement dans le plat de cuisson en terre cuite.

foods.description: Lumachine cotte in brodo speziato con erbe, aglio e aromi, servite come tapa stagionale soprattutto in primavera. neighborhoods.name: Santa Cruz
neighborhoods.description: L'ex quartiere ebraico di Siviglia, oggi il cuore turistico della città. Vicoli bianchi e fioriti, l'Alcázar, la Cattedrale e la Giralda a portata di piedi. Atmosfera romantica e pittoresca. Prezzi alti ma posizione insuperabile. Ideale per la prima visita.
neighborhoods.description_en: Seville's former Jewish quarter, today the tourist heart of the city. White flower-filled alleyways, the Alcázar, the Cathedral and the Giralda all within walking distance. Romantic and picturesque atmosphere. High prices but unbeatable location. Ideal for a first visit.
neighborhoods.description_fr: L’ancien quartier juif de Séville est aujourd’hui le cœur touristique de la ville. Ruelles blanches fleuries, Alcázar, cathédrale et Giralda sont tous accessibles à pied. Atmosphère romantique et pittoresque. Prix élevés, mais emplacement imbattable. Idéal pour une première visite.

neighborhoods.name: Triana
neighborhoods.description: Il quartiere popolare sulla riva ovest del Guadalquivir, patria del flamenco, della ceramica e delle tapas più autentiche. Mercato di Triana, ristoranti locali e grande atmosfera. Prezzi medi, molto amato da chi vuole vivere Siviglia come un locale.
neighborhoods.description_en: The popular neighbourhood on the west bank of the Guadalquivir, home of flamenco, ceramics and the most authentic tapas. Triana market, local restaurants and great atmosphere. Medium prices, very popular with those wanting to experience Seville like a local.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Le quartier populaire de la rive ouest du Guadalquivir, berceau du flamenco, de la céramique et des tapas les plus authentiques. Marché de Triana, restaurants locaux et excellente ambiance. Prix moyens, très apprécié de ceux qui souhaitent vivre Séville comme un habitant.

neighborhoods.name: La Macarena
neighborhoods.description: Quartiere popolare a nord del centro storico, con le mura romane, chiese barocche e una vivace vita quotidiana. Poco turistica, molto autentica. Ottimi ristoranti locali e tapas bar frequentati solo dai sivigliani. Prezzi accessibili.
neighborhoods.description_en: A popular district north of the historic centre, with Roman walls, baroque churches and a lively daily life. Not very touristy, very authentic. Excellent local restaurants and tapas bars frequented only by Sevillians. Affordable prices.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Quartier populaire au nord du centre historique, avec murailles romaines, églises baroques et vie quotidienne animée. Peu touristique et très authentique. Excellents restaurants locaux et bars à tapas fréquentés presque uniquement par les Sévillans. Prix abordables.

neighborhoods.name: El Arenal
neighborhoods.description: Quartiere storico tra la Cattedrale e il fiume, con la Maestranza (la più bella plaza de toros di Spagna) e il Teatro de la Maestranza. Ottima posizione centrale, ristoranti di qualità e hotel di fascia media. Meno trafficato di Santa Cruz ma altrettanto comodo.
neighborhoods.description_en: Historic district between the Cathedral and the river, with La Maestranza (the most beautiful bullring in Spain) and the Teatro de la Maestranza. Excellent central location, quality restaurants and mid-range hotels. Less busy than Santa Cruz but equally convenient.

Excellent emplacement central, restaurants de qualité et hôtels de gamme moyenne. Moins fréquenté que Santa Cruz, mais tout aussi pratique.
